Source ledger

War Risk Index sources

The site separates live data, benchmark methodology, and competitor context so readers can see what the score does and does not claim.

Live signal

GDELT Project

Used as the live open-news backbone because it monitors global print, broadcast, and web news and updates primary streams every 15 minutes.

API mode

GDELT DOC 2.0 API

Used for timeline and article-list responses. The site reads JSON output and stores derived snapshots in Cloudflare D1.

Conflict benchmark

ACLED Conflict Index

Used as methodology context for conflict intensity lenses such as deadliness, civilian danger, diffusion, and armed-group fragmentation.

Dataset benchmark

UCDP API documentation

Used to frame structured conflict data availability and the difference between event datasets and a live news-pressure signal.

Fallback signal

Wikimedia Analytics API

Used only when GDELT is unavailable or rate-limited. It represents public attention to conflict pages, not event intensity.

Tracker language

CFR Global Conflict Tracker methodology

Used for conflict-status language around violence, humanitarian impact, and escalation risk.

Competitive context

warriskindex.org

Reviewed as an exact-match competitor. War Risk Index Blog differentiates by publishing the data formula and live source boundary.

Non-affiliation

War Risk Index is independent. It is not affiliated with GDELT, ACLED, UCDP, CFR, Google, any government, insurer, broker, military organization, or the operators of similarly named sites.
